description: This PHP source file defines the AuthProviderDao class, which provides data access methods for handling OpenID authentication providers, provider details, and user identities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, and deleting provider records, as well as fetching providers for login display and handling search filters.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing OpenID authentication providers, provider details, and user identities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Fetches an OpenIdProvider entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for an auth provider given its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns an array of auth providers matching specified search filters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginated query for auth provider details based on search filters.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Returns the number of auth providers matching the search filters.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Deletes or deactivates auth providers by setting their status to false.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Persists an OpenIdProvider entity to the database.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persists an AuthProviderExtraDetails entity to the database.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Retrieves active OpenIdProviders for display on the login page.

methods.name: saveUserIdentity
methods.description: Saves an OpenIdUserIdentity entity, typically after a user authenticates.
